name: Novita AI Agent Sandbox

modes.label: Pay-as-you-go (prepaid balance)
modes.note: $0.0000098/vCPU-s + $0.0000032/GiB-s on allocation, per second. RAM in 512 MiB steps (0.5-8 GiB). Paused = $0 compute. Same rates in both regions (us-phx-1 v2, us-virginia-1 v1). Sessions > 1 h need long_running metadata (default timeout 5 min, cap 1 h without it; docs/guides/sandbox-long-running). Verified 2026-09-28: CPU 'Billed based on the number of vCPU cores used and usage duration', RAM on 'allocated memory capacity and usage duration'; paused: 'CPU and RAM stop being billed' (docs.novita.ai/guides/sandbox-pricing). Running-but-idle bills in full. 'Timeout is the maximum lifetime ... regardless of activity' (default onTimeout kill); an opt-in 'Idle timeout only fires when no client is connected for the configured duration' (docs.novita.ai/guides/sandbox-auto-resume.md).

modes.label: GPU Instance on-demand (H100 SXM 80GB, L40S, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RTX 6000 Ada)
modes.note: Novita GPU Instances, not the Agent Sandbox. Per-GPU hourly incl. a fixed host share (H100 SXM 22 vCPU/150 GiB; L40S and RTX 6000 Ada 22c/125 GiB; RTX 4090 16c/62 GiB; RTX 5090 16c/58 GiB), max 8 GPUs, 60 GB free root storage. Rendered novita.ai/gpus 2026-09-28: H100 SXM 3.39, L40S 0.55, RTX 4090 0.33, RTX 6000 Ada 0.77 /hr/GPU; RTX 5090 0.56 from the first-party market products API (price/100000) only. Live stock was 0 for 4090/5090/6000 Ada at capture; not guaranteed. Region not returned by the catalogue. max_vcpu/max_ram_gib set to the smallest (5090) host envelope. Serverless GPU worker prices unpublished; Dedicated Endpoints (H100 1.99, H200 2.99, 4090 0.61) are a different inference product, not modelled.

modes.label: GPU Instance spot (H100 SXM 80GB, RTX 4090, RTX 6000 Ada)
modes.note: Spot GPU Instances: 1 h initial protection, then 1 h reclaim notice. Rendered novita.ai/gpus 2026-09-28: H100 1.70, RTX 4090 0.17, RTX 6000 Ada 0.39 (API 0.385) /hr/GPU; L40S no spot.

plans.name: Free (no top-up)
plans.note: Default until account balance is topped up / credit line enabled; the $100 promo credit is spent under these limits. No priority scheduling.

plans.name: Paid (pay-as-you-go)
plans.note: Unlocks when balance > $0. Session cap conflicting: 24 h (landing), 3 h (docs quota table), long_running examples up to 720 h.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom contract; all limits adjustable (landing says unlimited concurrency); region selection, dedicated infra, 99.95% SLA. Pricing not published.

perf_source: cpu_runs_s 13.52: hpc-sandbox-benchmarks (branch provider/ascii-box, docs/results/2026-08-24-cpu), row from July CI run 30019301067 (2026-07-23), microVM template pinned 4 vCPU / 8 GiB, us-phx-1 (n=10). Not in ComputeSDK.

knobs.label: Idle time billed until the sandbox timeout fires (× session hours)
knobs.why: Default timeout is 5 min and the default onTimeout action is kill; a sandbox you do not kill or pause keeps billing CPU+RAM on allocation until the timeout fires (up to 1 h without long_running, longer with it). Default 1 = killed/paused when work ends; the 2x ceiling is a judgment call.

knobs.label: Share of session actually running (onTimeout=pause + autoResume / idle_timeout)
knobs.why: Paused sandboxes cost $0 compute (state moves to Persistent Storage: 60 GB free per account, then $0.00009/GB-h). With onTimeout=pause + autoResume or an idle_timeout (60-86,400 s), only running time bills. Default 1 = running for the whole session.

caveats: Isolation technology not documented (E2B-derived envd, memory snapshots, virtio-mem suggest a microVM; unverified).

Persistent storage (paused sandboxes + templates + snapshots) has a 60 GB free allowance per ACCOUNT (extra key snapshot_free_gib_account), then $0.00009/GB-h = $0.0657/GB-month; billed daily (landing: 'first 60 GB included daily'). Exact metering interval not documented. An engine ignoring the allowance overstates small snapshot bills.
Paused sandbox state includes memory; its GB size is not documented.
Max session: 1 h default cap without long_running; Paid 3 h (docs quota table) vs 24 h (landing); long_running examples 168 h / 720 h.
Default timeout 5 min and default onTimeout action is kill.
The $100 promo credit may not unlock Paid-tier limits; Paid requires a top-up or credit line. Credit validity period unspecified.
No minimum billed duration or per-start fee documented (Novita blog: 'no additional per-session startup fee').
Egress, volume (beta) and Enterprise pricing not published.
Overdue prepaid balance terminates sandboxes with data loss; no spend caps.
Ephemeral disk fixed at 20 GB (Enterprise adjustable); no per-GB disk upgrade price.
Benchmarks: only hpc CPU (13.52 Node.js tooling runs/s, n=10); no computesdk cold-start/burst/dax data.
Idle auto-stop exists but is off by default (must be configured), so the estimator does not apply idle suspension; set a pinned offer if you enable it.

GPU Instances (novita.ai/gpus) are a separate GPU-cloud product from the CPU Agent Sandbox, modelled as alt-flagged gpu_only modes (patch v4-gpu, 2026-09-28). PPIO (ppio-sandbox card, China, CNY 0.108/vCPU-h + 0.054/GiB-h) is a separately billed offer; engineering overlap with Novita is visible (novita-gym PPIO templates) but common ownership / shared credits are unverified (patch v10-regional).

GPU Instance regimes un-flagged alt (fix 2026-09-28): an ordinary self-serve GPU VM product; prices re-rendered from novita.ai/gpus 2026-09-28 (H100 SXM 3.39 / spot 1.70 /hr/GPU). Egress is still not published on docs.novita.ai/guides/sandbox-pricing or novita.ai/sandbox (egress_gib stays null).

fleet.verification: Free promotional credit requires account setup survey, no card; real balance top-up or credit line activates paid tier.
fleet.tiers: Free 5; Paid 100 after top-up; Enterprise 500 default, adjustable via support.
fleet.notes: 10/50 paid self-serve; 300 Enterprise; 1,000 requires quota request. Docs say paid max session 3h while landing page says 24h, so duration needs confirmation. Aggregate vCPU/GPU account quotas and approval delay not stated.
